title: Positive Output Probability Gives a Witness
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $x,v$ be binary words and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. If the fraction of length-$t$ choice words on which $N$ outputs $v$ is positive, then some length-$t$ choice word makes $N$ output exactly $v$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite-state nondeterministic machine over Bool
x and v are Bool lists
The output probability of v on x after t choice bits is positive
